name: Create a hunt and resolve the first attack
description: Verifies the critical play loop creates a real campaign session and commits one deterministic combat turn.
steps: Enter adventurer name Rook and create a hunt
Confirm Chapter 1, a six-character session code, and Turn 1 are visible
expected: The turn advances, the Warden result appears in the Shared Chronicle, Dungeon Master narration is visible, and any successful hit changes real HP and score.

name: Second adventurer joins and receives realtime campaign updates
description: Verifies two browsers share one canonical hunt and accepted turns propagate without refresh.
setup: Actor A creates a hunt as Rook and keeps the six-character session code
steps: Actor B joins as Ash using Actor A's session code
Confirm both clients show the green realtime session indicator
Actor A performs the currently legal action while Actor B does not refresh
expected: Actor B automatically sees the updated turn, HP or objective state, score, and Shared Chronicle entry.

name: Complete Chapter I and descend to the Bone Rookery
description: Verifies Chapter I transitions only after its real objective and enemy are resolved.
steps: Choose Awaken Altar and confirm Ember Feather appears
Alternate Defend and Attack on legal turns until the Crowbound Warden reaches 0 HP
expected: Chapter 2 The Bone Rookery becomes visible, the enemy changes to Bone Rook, the relic remains stored, and living party members begin the new chapter fully restored.

name: Finish the full three-chapter campaign
description: Verifies the campaign has a real deterministic finish instead of an endless prototype room.
steps: In Chapter II use Cleanse Rookery until it succeeds no later than rite 3/3, then alternate Defend and Attack until the Bone Rook falls
In Chapter III use Break Crown until it succeeds no later than rite 3/3, then alternate Defend and Attack until the Black Rook falls
Attempt to use an action after victory
expected: The Black Rook Oath victory banner appears with final score and three relics, campaign status remains victory, and action controls cannot mutate the finished hunt.

name: Party defeat ends the hunt on mobile
description: Verifies defeat remains a real terminal game state even though a sound defensive strategy is survivable.
steps: Create a hunt as Ash on mobile
Use Speak repeatedly on legal turns so the enemy retaliates while taking no attack damage
Continue until the adventurer reaches 0 HP
expected: A defeat banner appears, the adventurer is marked FALLEN, and all turn actions are disabled so the ended hunt cannot mutate.
